title: 選ばれた十六皿
change: 前日に予約した客が再訪。ロウを隊長として紹介し、ギルドの試食依頼が届く。供給は16食の枠を維持。大口契約はまだ成立しない。
state: 前日に予約した客が再訪。ロウを隊長として紹介し、ギルドの試食依頼が届く。供給は16食の枠を維持。大口契約はまだ成立しない。

sources.description: Morning in same diner; Elna lays three clean bowls at reserved table, then Kou opens door and Row arrives without crowd. Close detail three blank reservation tokens then smile of recognizing one another.
dialogue:
本当に
来てくれた

俺はロウ
この隊の隊長だ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: At same table Row eats same six-copper stew and bread; apprentice adventurer asks the price then puts six copper coins on dry table; Kou replies at counter, no inflated quantities or luxury gold. The anonymous speaker is the helmeted dark-haired male companion from episode 11 in brown leather and a gray shirt, never Row. Row remains silent in the establishing view.
dialogue:
はい
今日も同じです
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Later same morning modest garden, Kou harvests only mature marked leaf patch with Balt nearby, rejects damaged leaf to separate compost basket, hand closeup clean viable leaves in separate produce crate. No immature area harvested.
dialogue:
採れる列が
増えたな

待った分が
追いついた

傷んだ葉は
店には回さない
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Kitchen Elna chops clean carrot and braises beef, paired narrow knife and pan sound moments, then her calm concentration. Kou brings washed selected leaves to separate prep sink; leaf freshness and portion predictable. Wash vegetables in a handmade oval hammered-copper basin with a simple wooden gravity spout and aged bronze colander, no chrome faucet or stainless rectangular modern sink.
dialogue:
届く葉が
揃ってると
火に集中できる

今日は
この大きさで揃えた
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Several modest guests at noon table enjoy eating without all speaking; one normal trader in background observes queue; Row praises Elna face-to-face, Elna blushing with proud professionalism rather than romance. Only three spoken beats. Row companions remain the anonymous helmeted man and short brown-bob-haired woman in brown traveling clothes from episode 11; no Sera or Rodel.
dialogue:
うまい飯が
明日もある
それが助かる

明日も
待ってるよ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Leon silver-gray hair navy cloak eyebrow scar enters later at quiet hour, holds folded blank paper, Elna and Kou present across dry table. Wide entrance then separate face closeups, not a huge royal visit.
dialogue:
店の噂が
ギルドまで来た

次は
味も確かめたい
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Leon opens simple blank tasting invitation at desk. Kou hears requirement, Elna checks serving portions mentally, Leon nods. No signed large order, no unreadable tiny text printed on paper.
dialogue:
同じ予算で
三組に出してもらう

私たちも
出していいの？

名ではなく
皿で選ぶ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Quiet after closing kitchen: Kou sets selected vegetables near Elna; a large confident face of Elna decides, Kou smiles approvingly, last borderless warm two-shot at blue awning. No comparison outcome revealed yet.
dialogue:
出そう
私たちの定食を

いつもの仕事で
勝ちに行こう
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める
